plans.idea: Classic centred tall poster: logo crowns the top on the centre axis, headline and subhead beneath it, a large bottle as the centrepiece, and a centred CTA anchoring the bottom, so every element shares one vertical axis instead of the current mix of right logo, left text and centred bottle.

Product-first story: a small left-aligned logo, then a near-full-width bottle across the upper half, then the headline and subhead with the CTA directly below them in one left-aligned message block at the bottom, read top to bottom from product to pitch to action.

Editorial left column: the logo, headline, subhead and CTA sit together as one tight left-edge message block in the top half (fixing the big dead gap between the copy and the bottle), and the bottle fills the whole bottom half as a strong visual base.
